Role: Technical Product Manager, AI Infra Resilience
Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA
Level: Expert/Leader (Level 5/6)

Requirements:
- 12+ years total experience
- 5+ years in product management, solutions architecture, software engineering, or SRE on technical infrastructure
- Technical depth in GPU or AI infrastructure
- GPU failure modes (XID codes, ECC errors, DCGM metrics, NVLink, PCIe health signals)
- Why AI workloads fail (NCCL timeouts, framework errors, hardware vs software faults)
- Telemetry sources (DCGM, sysfs, dmesg)

- Bachelor's in CS or equivalent

Preferred:
- Former SRE or infra engineer on GPU clusters (triaged job failures, parsed XID logs)
- GPU scheduling (Slurm, Kueue, Kubernetes schedulers, topology-aware placement)
- Building structured diagnostics products (health verdicts, log analysis, observability APIs)
- Open-source infrastructure project experience

Responsibilities:
- Workload failure attribution and telemetry
